scripts.build-local: anchor build -p dynamic_bonding_curve --ignore-keys --tools-version v1.57 --arch v3 -- --features local
scripts.build-local-test: bun run build-local && bunx ts-mocha --runInBand -p ./tsconfig.json -t 1000000 tests/*.tests.ts
scripts.build-local-ctest: bun run build-local && bunx ts-mocha --runInBand -p ./tsconfig.json -t 1000000 tests/backwards_compatibility/*.tests.ts
